The '''Sword Ninja''' is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']]''. 

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:SwordNinjaNES1.png|80px]]

Sword Ninjas are first introduced in [[Basilisk Mine Field|Act 4-2]]. They fall straight down from the top of the screen, then leap forward a good distance in Ryu's direction to attack. Once they land, they run forward for a second with sword out. After that second passes, they jump again, and this is how they redirect themselves at Ryu. They only deal 1 point of damage on contact, and are easily defeated in one hit by any attack.
